title: The Quiet Word
subtitle: Silent, and left out of Claim all
description: The other command reward, done properly: `silent: true` says
nothing in chat, and `excludeFromClaimAll: true` leaves it for its
own press -- Claim all collects everything outstanding except the
rewards that ask to be claimed deliberately, and this is what that

rewards.command: title @s actionbar {p} hears the quiet word
